Wall Street is holding a watch party tonight — and your 401(k) is on the guest list.

Nvidia reports earnings after today's close. It's the most valuable company in the world and the single biggest stock in the S&P 500 — about 8% of the whole index. If you own an index fund or a target-date 401(k), it's quietly your largest bet.

Investors will read the report as a verdict on the AI boom. The stock has slipped from its $5 trillion peak going in.

My take: you don't have to watch the ticker. But one company now moves the fund millions of people retire on.

Do you know how much of your portfolio is Nvidia?
